title: A Group-Specific Approach to NLP for Hate Speech Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of antisemitic stereotypes and hate speech, including historical and religious myths like blood libel and the deicide charge against Jewish people.
findings: Infusing a custom knowledge graph of antisemitic history and language ('KnowledJe') into hate speech detection models (Logistic Regression and DistilBERT) can improve performance in identifying antisemitic content. This group-specific approach helps models detect subtle stereotypes, historical allusions, and coded language that knowledge-poor baseline models often miss.
references: Badr AlKhamissi, Faisal Ladhak, Srini Iyer, Ves Stoyanov, Zornitsa Kozareva, Xian Li, Pascale Fung, Lambert Mathias, Asli Celikyilmaz, and Mona Diab. 2022. Token: Task decomposition and knowledge infusion for few-shot hate speech detection.
